Mosquito Scanner 0.4
Application source: source.zip and https://github.com/dangnani-pixel/mosquito-scanner, AGPL-3.0-or-later. License: LICENSE.txt.
Model: YOLito by Evyatar Sar-Shalom and collaborators.
Source: https://github.com/WildMosquit0/YOLito
Paper: https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.11.20.689454
Original weights: weights/best.pt, SHA256 cbcc0812977a81958a849d249d19246069596acaa2799b832de86e0cce7e0841.
Original checkpoint metadata specifies AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics).
Architecture: YOLO11l, one detection class. Original class name '1' is displayed as 'mosquito estimate' based on the model repository's mosquito detection purpose.
Converted with Ultralytics 8.3.65 to ONNX opset 17 at 640x640. Float32 initializers stored as float16 with Cast nodes restoring float32 for WebAssembly execution. This is a format conversion, not newly trained on household images.
App preprocessing: RGB / 255; letterbox 114; 640x640; full-image plus overlapping tile inference; confidence threshold selectable; IoU NMS 0.35 plus containment merge 0.7 for tile-edge duplicates; up to 10 small dark spots re-analyzed on enlarged crops, and tap-to-zoom on a tapped dark spot; photo long side capped at 1920 px.
Model and runtime are served locally by this site. No photos or microphone recordings are transmitted. Downloaded model parts are verified against the manifest SHA-256 and kept in browser Cache Storage.
Model loading requires approximately 49 MB plus 11 MB runtime. Memory and speed vary by browser/device.
Research demonstration image used in development: https://github.com/WildMosquit0/YOLito/blob/main/demo/dead.jpeg
A successful demonstration-image check does not establish accuracy on new indoor images.
Sound AI: HumBug MozzBNN mosquito event detector (University of Oxford, HumBug project), MIT License, model/HUMBUG-LICENSE.txt.
Source: https://github.com/HumBug-Mosquito/MozzBNN and https://github.com/HumBug-Mosquito/HumBugDB
Paper: Kiskin et al., "HumBugDB: a large-scale acoustic mosquito dataset", NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks.
Weights: neurips_2021_humbugdb_keras_bnn_best.hdf5 (SHA256 f2e81a8a5869e1fd1329db29bed68549db9cad8d4e1000ae415a5ac5f1c2a321), rebuilt as ONNX by export_humbug.py with MC dropout kept active (10 samples per analysis).
Sound preprocessing matches MozzBNN/librosa: 8 kHz, STFT 2048/512 Hann centred reflect, 128 Slaney mel, power_to_db ref=max top_db=80, standardised per 1.92 s window (the original standardises per recording).
Conversion check on MozzBNN's sample recording: 99.1% of 1.92 s windows agree with the published output (whole-recording normalisation); 96.8% with per-window normalisation used live.
App-side gate: a hit also requires a 250-1000 Hz spectral peak >= 9.5 dB above the band median; 2 hits in the last 3 analyses mark a detection. Not validated on Korean species or indoor household noise.
ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0: Microsoft, MIT License, vendor/ONNXRUNTIME-LICENSE.txt.
